decisions.reason: Its low-cost integration with the established offer and still-relevant secure channel make the option worth keeping.
As a foundational multi-layer security architecture, it carries low marginal cost and remains core to the firm's broader ecosystem.
Hardware token carrying costs are high and by 2022 its prospects have likely resolved as limited, so the option no longer justifies further commitment given many other options.
The compliance suite has moderate regulatory upkeep but builds on established capabilities and may still realize value in payment security.
